summary:
Hi, my name is Aradhya Patil, a 13-year-old solo developer:
Created for the NASA Space Apps Challenge, the Astronaut Health Monitor is an innovative web application engineered to solve the critical challenge of real-time crew health tracking in microgravity. Deep space missions expose astronauts to severe physiological hazards like rapid fluid shifts, bone density loss, and cosmic radiation. My solution features live vital sign telemetry, an interactive 3D cardiovascular and organ scan simulator, detailed daily nutrition and hydration schedules, and immediate microgravity emergency protocols. To prepare explorers for autonomous deep space challenges, it also includes psychomotor vigilance testing and a simulated Mars communication delay. By bridging medical science with advanced web software, this winning project guarantees absolute crew safety and operational mission readiness for the future of space exploration!
details:
Hi, my name is Aradhya Patil, a 13-year-old solo developer.

  • How it works: Built as a standalone HTML/JavaScript web application, it runs instantly in any browser without external servers. It uses JavaScript simulation loops and HTML5 Canvas to render live vital sign telemetry, animated cardiovascular blood flow, and interactive organ scans.
    astronaut-health-monitor
  • Benefits & Impact: Continuously monitors multi-crew health, detects anomalies, and provides immediate emergency protocols for microgravity hazards like fluid shifts, hypoxia, and solar flares. It ensures astronaut safety and autonomous decision-making during deep space missions—complete with a simulated Mars communication delay.
    astronaut-health-monitor
  • Tech Stack: Developed using HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript, leveraging Canvas graphics for biological visualizations and live trend charts.
    astronaut-health-monitor
  • Creativity: Uniquely combines live fault injection (simulating solar flares or scrubber failures), psychomotor vigilance reaction testing, and daily microgravity scheduling into a single immersive interface.
    astronaut-health-monitor
